public_rationale: OpenAI's participant data published on January 31, 2024 contain 25 experts in each assignment group [e1]. Joining assignments to formulation scores gives four LLM-assisted experts and one internet-only expert scoring at least 8/10 [e2]. The observed proportions are 16% and 4%, supporting the claimed fourfold ratio for this sample and scoring threshold [e2].
limitations: The sample proportions do not establish a fourfold effect in the wider expert population [e1, e2].
The measured outcome is a formulation accuracy score, not demonstrated physical pathogen production [e2].
